_comment: GitHub Actions minutes budget (US-SPEC-24). Minutes are Linux-equivalent: other runners count at price / linux_minute_rate_usd. Free org plan includes USD 12 of compute a month (about 2000 Linux minutes at 0.006); this file keeps total below that. The workers repository's own workflows are rostered by file name (ci.yml, selfhost.yml, loops.yml, self-start.yml, idea-intake.yml, release.yml); pages.yml, docs-link-check.yml and dependabot-auto.yml stay rostered for the other repositories of the organization, which this checkout cannot read.
